attio-api.free_tier: Free tier: up to 3 seats, 50,000 records, API access included; no card required; 14-day trial of Pro plan

intercom-api.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <access_token> (workspace access token for private apps; OAuth for public apps)

mailchimp-marketing-api.notes: No official Marketing API MCP; community servers exist (e.g. damientilman/mailchimp-mcp-server). Mailchimp's official MCP (mandrillapp.com/mcp) covers only Transactional. API base URL includes account-specific data-center subdomain.

pipedrive-api.notes: Official hosted MCP at mcp.pipedrive.ai/mcp uses Pipedrive account sign-in (OAuth). Offers a free Sandbox account for development/testing separate from production pricing.

salesforce-apis.notes: Salesforce-hosted MCP servers (GA 2026, e.g. sobject-all: CRUD, query, search) need the MCP Service enabled and an External Client App for OAuth. The local salesforcecli/mcp server covers DX/DevOps tooling (metadata deploy, Apex, LWC).

zendesk-api.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <oauth_token> (Basic {email}/token:{api_token} still works but is deprecated)

adyen-api.notes: Requires an approved Adyen merchant account before API keys are issued; no self-serve free signup like Stripe. Official local MCP server (alpha) covers Checkout and Management APIs.

coinbase-cdp-x402.free_tier: Free tier: CDP x402 Facilitator free for 1,000 onchain transactions/month, then $0.001/tx; payment verification always free
coinbase-cdp-x402.notes: x402 is an open HTTP-402 payment protocol Coinbase champions, not a single vendor API - useful for agent-to-agent micropayments. Official local Payments MCP (npx @coinbase/payments-mcp) combines a wallet, onramp and x402 payments.

coingecko-api.free_tier: Free tier: Demo API plan 10,000 calls/month, 100 calls/min, attribution required; keyless free MCP with shared rate limits

financial-modeling-prep.notes: Many endpoints (full financial statements, etc.) require a paid plan. Official hosted MCP takes the key as ?apikey=<API_KEY>.

paypal-api.notes: Remote MCP transports: /http (Streamable HTTP) or /sse; separate sandbox MCP endpoint at https://mcp.sandbox.paypal.com for testing.

plaid-api.free_tier: Free: Sandbox always free; Trial plan for new US/Canada teams (since 2026-04-15) gives 10 Production Items; then pay-as-you-go
plaid-api.notes: Dashboard MCP (OAuth client_credentials, scope mcp:dashboard) needs Production access; a local Sandbox MCP is in plaid/ai-coding-toolkit. Production requires a Plaid approval/compliance review.

stripe-api.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <secret_key>; from 2026-10-31 MCP accepts only OAuth or Agent-tagged API keys (others get 401)

wise-api.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <API token> (personal, Wise business accounts) or OAuth2 (Wise Platform partners)
wise-api.notes: Personal tokens cover only quotes, recipients, transfers, batch groups and transfer events; funding and balance statements only for US/CA/AU/NZ/SG/MY accounts. Full access needs a partnership agreement.

cloudflare-sandbox-sdk.notes: Not a hosted API called directly with a key - you deploy your own Worker using the SDK on Cloudflare Containers/Durable Objects. The official Container MCP is a generic sandbox, not a Sandbox SDK wrapper.

daytona.notes: Billed per second; supports sandbox snapshots and preview URLs for web apps. Official MCP server runs locally via the Daytona CLI (daytona mcp start); no hosted endpoint.

e2b.free_tier: Trial: one-time $100 usage credit on signup (Hobby, no card); up to 1 h per sandbox, 20 concurrent; then pay-as-you-go
e2b.notes: Sandboxes auto-expire after a configurable timeout (default ~5 min); used by many agent frameworks (OpenHands, etc.). The e2b-dev/mcp-server repo was archived and deprecated on 2026-04-16.

judge0.free_tier: Paid only on Judge0 Cloud (Pro EUR 27/mo for 2,000 submissions/day and up); self-host free & open-source (GPLv3)

piston.auth_hint: authorization token for the public emkc.org instance, granted by EngineerMan (Discord) only for non-commercial educational projects; none when self-hosted
piston.free_tier: Free: self-host (open source); public emkc.org API no longer open since 2026-02-15, token only for non-commercial educational projects
piston.notes: Public emkc.org instance closed to open use on 2026-02-15; self-host via Docker for agent workloads. Widely used by Discord/Slack bots.

riza.free_tier: Free tier: Hobby plan free forever, 100,000 requests/month, 30 s execution limit; then usage-based pricing

runloop.notes: Official local MCP server @runloop/api-client-mcp (npx, RUNLOOP_API_KEY) exposes the Runloop API; the 'MCP Hub' feature lets Devboxes connect outward to other MCP servers.
